title.id: Peluncuran Peta Ancaman Siber 3D Interaktif dan Animasi Telemetri Taktis
title.en: Launch of Interactive 3D Cyber Threat Map and Tactical Telemetry Animations

body.id: Menghadirkan fitur visualisasi keamanan siber tingkat lanjut yang terinspirasi dari ThreatsEye ke dalam ekosistem Pasax. Dilengkapi peta bola dunia 3D interaktif berbasis Three.js dengan lintasan serangan balistik real-time, widget radar keliling 360 derajat dengan dok kemampuan terintegrasi, visualisasi aliran data pertahanan tiga lapis (Triple Defense Flow Network), serta bilah status telemetri langsung.
body.en: Introduced advanced cybersecurity visualizations inspired by ThreatsEye into the Pasax ecosystem. Features a Three.js-powered interactive 3D rotating globe with real-time ballistic attack arcs, a 360-degree tactical perimeter radar with an interactive capability dock, a 3-stage Triple Defense Flow Network dataflow visualizer, and live telemetry ticker bars.

items.id: Peta Bola Dunia Ancaman Siber 3D (/threats-map): Menampilkan rotasi bumi 3D, batas benua, lintasan proyektil serangan berkilau, lingkaran riak gelombang kejut pada node pertahanan Sentinel, tombol alih proyeksi 2D/3D, dan dok fokus cepat antar-benua.
items.en: Interactive 3D Cyber Threat Map (/threats-map): Features 3D earth rotation, continent boundaries, ballistic projectile arcs with traveling energy comets, impact shockwave ripples on Sentinel nodes, a 2D/3D projection toggle, and continent quick-focus docks.

items.id: Aliran Umpan Ancaman Siber Real-time: Panel sisi umpan serangan langsung dengan indikator keparahan, bendera negara asal penyerang, lencana mitigasi (nftables, Shield WAF, Honeypot), filter kategori, dan pengatur kecepatan stream.
items.en: Real-time Cyber Threat Feeds: Live attack feed sidebar featuring severity badges, attacker geolocation flags, defense mitigation tags (nftables kernel drops, Shield WAF, Honeypots), category filters, and stream rate controls.

items.id: Widget Radar Taktis 360 Derajat & Aliran Pertahanan 3 Lapis: Menambahkan animasi sapuan sinar radar 360° dengan target ancaman aktif, dok diagnostik (Perimeter, nftables, FIM, Mesh), serta visualisasi aliran data terinspeksi dari middleware PHP hingga kernel Linux.
items.en: 360° Tactical Perimeter Radar & Triple-Defense Flow: Added a rotating 360° radar sweep widget with active target blips, capability docks, and an interactive dataflow visualizer bridging PHP middleware down to Linux kernel eBPF drops.

items.id: Integrasi Navigasi & Ticker Status Mesin: Tautan langsung Threat Map dengan titik berdenyut merah di bilah navigasi utama dan bilah sisi konsol SOC, serta bilah status telemetri langsung di bawah bagian hero beranda.
items.en: Navigation Integration & Live Telemetry Ticker: Integrated Threat Map navigation links with pulsing red live indicators in the public header and SOC sidebar, plus a real-time mesh telemetry bar below the hero section.
